description: This file contains acceptance tests for the EmailTemplates module in the SuiteCRM project. It uses the Codeception testing framework to verify viewing and creating email templates functionality, including interactions with the TinyMCE editor.

classes.name: EmailTemplatesCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for EmailTemplates module, containing setup and test scenarios for viewing and creating email templates.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test to initialize fake data generator with a seed.

methods.name: testScenarioViewEmailTemplatesModule
methods.description: Test to verify that an administrator can view the emailTemplates module list view.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateEmailTemplate
methods.description: Test to verify that an administrator can create and delete an email template, testing the TinyMCE editor.
